name: Chameleon, Master of Disguise
oracle_text:
You may have Chameleon enter as a copy of a creature you control, except his name is Chameleon, Master of Disguise.
Mayhem {2}{U} (You may cast this card from your graveyard for {2}{U} if you discarded it this turn. Timing rules still apply.)
blocked_sentences: You may have Chameleon enter as a copy of a creature you control, except his name is Chameleon, Master of Disguise.

needs.what: a self_enters_as_copy replacement (copying {zone: battlefield, types: [Creature], controller: you}) whose 707.9b exception sets the copy's name to the card's own printed name, so the copy keeps 'Chameleon, Master of Disguise' as its name (legend rule and name checks read it) while taking every other copiable value from the chosen creature
needs.why_existing_wont_do: self_enters_as_copy is not in this packet's reference, and in the engine its except_ accepts only add_keywords (the loader rejects any other key); become_copy has except_name but is an op, so running it from a self_enters trigger would let the creature be seen as itself first (614.1b) rather than entering as the copy; rename_permanent renames a non-copying permanent
